rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a relay race between teams.

example.english: We signed up for the relay race, so everyone has to coordinate the handoffs.
example.traditional: 我哋報咗名參加接力賽，大家要夾好交棒先得。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 bou3 zo2 ming4 caam1 gaa1 zip3 lik6 coi3 daai6 gaa1 jiu3 gaap3 hou2 gaau1 paang5 sin1 dak1

rows.note: Use this technical noun for an electrical relay that controls a larger current or voltage.

example.english: The engineer said the relay is broken and needs replacing immediately.
example.traditional: 工程師話個繼電器壞咗，要即刻換。
example.jyutping: gung1 cing4 si1 waa6 go3 gai3 din6 hei3 waai6 zo2 jiu3 zik1 hak1 wun6
